fields.what_it_is: The GALAXY MIS Screw System is intended to provide immobilization and Stabilization of spinal segments in skeletally mature patients as an adjunct to fusion in the treatment of acute and chronic instabilities or deformities of the thoracic, lumbar and sacral spine.
fields.use_notes: MRI: Labeling does not contain MRI Safety Information. Sterilized: Moist Heat or Steam Sterilization. Single-use
also_known_as: Bone-screw internal spinal fixation system, non-sterile
